continuous_interval: 10000 bootstrap resamples of trial means; seed 6216
paired_difference_interval: Conservative Bonferroni-adjusted marginal exact binomial bounds; paired exact McNemar with Holm correction within method/disturbance families
failure_selection: First failed seed, none before disturbance: first reference-method task failure and first comparator failure for each comparator in config order. Preserve matched iterative trial regardless of outcome. Hero: lowest successful complete/iterative/none seed, if any.
supersession: User requested approximately 50 trials after visual_feedback_v1 began. Its scheduler was stopped; all started trials are retained separately and excluded from this new study. This balanced 48-trial protocol uses fresh seeds 400-407 and the unchanged controller. Only complete four-stage sequences are scored; stage metrics retain reachability counts and do not replace independent-task experiments.
interpretation: Frozen three-mode feedback evaluation, independent of historical 240/40 trials and the cancelled visual_feedback_v1 matrix. Development uses seed 0; 400-407 reserved. No guaranteed improvement. Open-loop retains common initial acquisition and visual feed prediction but disables post-grasp and post-release relocalization. Staged and iterative share estimator, depth correction and controller parameters; iterative additionally performs bounded repeated observations/corrections before contact. Dynamics advance by fixed simulated latency at feedback observations; wall inference/planning pauses remain explicit, so this is not a realtime hardware claim. All modes retain joint servo, force and collision guards. Eight trials per configuration give wide uncertainty; report results as exploratory simulation evidence.
